units.Ezekiel 7:2: “And you, son of man, say, ‘Thus says the Lord to the land of Israel: An end has come; the end has come upon the four wings of the land.

units.Psalms 36:14: The sinners drew a sword and stretched their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to slaughter the upright in heart.
units.Psalms 36:15: May their sword enter their own heart, and may their bows be shattered.
units.Psalms 36:16: Better is a little for the righteous than the great wealth of sinners.
units.Psalms 36:17: For the arms of sinners will be shattered, but the Lord sustains the righteous.
units.Psalms 36:18: The Lord knows the ways of the blameless, and their inheritance will last for ever.
units.Psalms 36:19: They will not be put to shame in an evil time, and in days of famine they will be filled.

units.Ezekiel 13:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

units.Ezekiel 13:6: They see false things and divine vain things, those who say, ‘The Lord says,’ although the Lord has not sent them; and they began to establish a word.
units.Ezekiel 13:7: Have you not seen a false vision and spoken vain divinations?

units.Luke 13:31: At that very hour some Pharisees approached and said to Him, “Leave and go away from here, because Herod wants to kill Thee.”

units.Luke 13:34: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children as a bird gathers her own brood under her wings, and you were not willing!

units.Ezekiel 16:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 16:2: “Son of man, solemnly testify to Jerusalem about her lawlessness,

units.Ezekiel 16:6: I passed by you and saw you befouled in your blood, and said to you, ‘From your blood, life!

units.Luke 2:1: In those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus for all the inhabited world to be registered.
units.Luke 2:2: This first registration took place while Quirinius was governing Syria.
units.Luke 2:3: Everyone went to be registered, each to his own city.
units.Luke 2:4: Joseph also went up from Galilee, from the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he belonged to David’s house and family,
units.Luke 2:5: to be registered with Mary, who was betrothed to him and was pregnant.
units.Luke 2:6: While they were there, the time came for her to give birth.
units.Luke 2:7: She bore her firstborn Son, wrapped Him in swaddling cloths, and laid Him in a manger, because there was no place for them in the lodging place.
units.Exodus 2:1: Now there was a man of the tribe of Levi, who took one of the daughters of Levi and had her as his wife.
units.Exodus 2:2: She conceived and bore a male child. Seeing that he was beautiful, they hid him for three months.
units.Exodus 2:3: When they could no longer hide him, his mother took a basket for him and coated it with bitumen-pitch. She put the child in it and placed it in the marsh beside the river.
units.Exodus 2:4: His sister watched from a distance to learn what would happen to him.
units.Exodus 2:5: Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe at the river while her attendants walked beside it. She saw the basket in the marsh, sent her attendant, and had it brought to her.
units.Exodus 2:6: And she opened it, and saw a child weeping in the basket; and Pharaoh’s daughter had compassion on him, and said, “This is one of the Hebrew children.”
units.Exodus 2:7: And his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Do you want me to call a nursing woman from among the Hebrews, that she may nurse the child for you?”
units.Exodus 2:8: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” The young woman went and called the child’s mother.
units.Exodus 2:9: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Keep this child for me, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.” And the woman took the child and nursed him.
units.Exodus 2:10: When the child grew, she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, saying, “I took him up out of the water.”
units.Ezekiel 20:18: I said to their children in the wilderness, “Do not walk in your fathers’ ordinances, do not keep their judgments, do not mix yourselves with their practices, and do not be defiled.
units.Ezekiel 20:19: I am the Lord your God. Walk in My commands, keep My ordinances and carry them out,
units.Ezekiel 20:20: and sanctify My sabbaths; let it be a sign between Me and you, so that you may know that I am the Lord your God.”
units.Ezekiel 20:21: Their children too embittered Me. They did not walk in My commands or keep My ordinances to carry them out, which a person will carry out and by which he will live; they were profaning My sabbaths. I said I would pour My wrath upon them in the wilderness and complete My anger upon them.
units.Ezekiel 20:22: I acted so that My name would not be profaned at all before the nations from whom I brought them out before their eyes.
units.Ezekiel 20:23: I raised My hand against them in the wilderness, to scatter them among the nations and disperse them among the countries,
units.Ezekiel 20:24: because they did not carry out My ordinances, rejected My commands and were profaning My sabbaths, while their eyes followed their fathers’ reflections.
units.Ezekiel 20:26: I will defile them through their gifts, when I pass through every one who opens the womb, so that I may destroy them.
units.Romans 7:7: What, then, shall we say? Is the law sin? May it never be! Rather, I did not know sin except through law; for I would not have known desire if the law had not said, “You shall not desire.”
units.Romans 7:8: But sin, taking opportunity through the commandment, produced every desire in me; for apart from law sin is dead.
units.Romans 7:9: And I was once alive apart from law; but when the commandment came, sin came to life,
units.Romans 7:10: and I died; and the commandment that was for life proved to bring me death.
units.Romans 7:11: For sin, taking opportunity through the commandment, deceived me and through it killed me.
units.Romans 7:12: So the law is holy, and the commandment holy and righteous and good.
units.Romans 7:13: Did the good, then, become death to me? May it never be! But sin did, so that it might appear as sin, producing death in me through the good, so that through the commandment sin might become sinful beyond measure.

units.Ezekiel 35:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 35:2: “Son of man, turn your face toward Mount Seir and prophesy against it,
units.Ezekiel 35:3: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir. I will stretch My hand against you and make you a wilderness, and you will be laid waste.
units.Ezekiel 35:4: I will make your cities desolate, and you will be a wilderness. You will know that I am the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 35:5: Because you became an everlasting enemy and ambushed Israel’s house treacherously, by enemies’ hand, with a sword at the final time of injustice,
units.Ezekiel 35:10: Because you said, “The two nations and the two countries will be mine, and I will inherit them,” and the Lord is there,
units.Ezekiel 35:11: therefore, I live, says the Lord: I will deal with you according to your hostility and make Myself known to you when I judge you.
units.Ezekiel 35:12: You will know that I am the Lord. I heard the voice of your blasphemies, because you said, “Israel’s mountains are desolate; they have been given to us for food.”
units.Ezekiel 35:13: You spoke grandly against Me with your mouth. I heard.
units.Ezekiel 35:15: You will be a wilderness, Mount Seir, and all Idumea will be utterly consumed. You will know that I am the Lord their God.’”
